name: Condemn
text: Select up to (X/2) visible enemy fighters. Those fighters are condemned. For each selected fighter, increase Zeal by 1. If the selected fighter is a `WIZARD`, `DAEMON` or `VAMPIRE`, increase Zeal by 3 instead.

name: Incite Rabble
text: Select a friendly `HENCHMAN` within 6" of this fighter. That `HENCHMAN` makes a free move action. Then, increase Zeal by 1.

name: Self-Flagellation
text: Allocate (X/2) damage points to this fighter and increase Zeal by 1. Add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee attack actions made by this fighter until the end of their activation.

name: Unshakeable
text: This fighter automatically passes any Panic tests it is required to take.

name: Penitent
text: This fighter cannot be equipped with ranged weapons or wear any armour.

name: Death Grip
text: After this fighter's next melee attack action in this activation, if at least 1 hit roll from that attack action results in a hit or a critical hit, the target forfeits 1 of their actions in this battle round. If the target has already activated or if they have no more actions to forfeit, allocate 3 damage points to the target instead.
